items.name: init
items.title: Expressive React
items.description: Theme tokens, utilities, icons and the ThemeProvider. Install this first.
items.docs: Next: add `@import "./styles/expressive.css";` (path relative to your CSS file) right after `@import "tailwindcss";`, wrap your app in <ThemeProvider>, and load Roboto Flex + Material Symbols Rounded from Google Fonts. See the README.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: M3 Expressive tokens for Tailwind CSS v4: color roles, type scale, shape, elevation, motion, state layers.
items.docs: Import it once, right after Tailwind: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "./styles/expressive.css";

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() and tv() configured for the Expressive type, shape and motion scales.

items.name: use-drag-scroll
items.title: useDragScroll
items.description: Mouse drag-to-scroll for overflow containers; suspends scroll-snap while dragging and settles on the nearest snap point with release velocity.

items.name: use-magnetic
items.title: useMagnetic
items.description: Element drifts toward the pointer and springs home on leave.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Live matchMedia result, SSR-safe (useSyncExternalStore).

items.name: use-motion
items.title: useMotion helpers
items.description: M3 Expressive spring timings for the Web Animations API, plus prefers-reduced-motion helpers.

items.name: use-press-scale
items.title: usePressScale
items.description: Elastic press: squish on pointer down, spring back on release.

items.name: use-tilt
items.title: useTilt
items.description: Perspective tilt toward the pointer with a spring reset.

items.name: use-window-size-class
items.title: useWindowSizeClass
items.description: M3 window size classes (compact · medium · expanded · large · extra-large) from the viewport width.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion (tonal, flush, outlined, list, expressive, numbered) and Collapsible on React Aria Disclosure, with spring height animation.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline alerts (info, success, warning, error; tonal, outlined, inverse) and the M3 banner.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: Decision dialogs: no scrim dismiss, destructive confirm on the error role, optional third action.

items.name: app-bar
items.title: App bar
items.description: M3 Expressive top app bars (small, center, medium & large flexible with collapse-on-scroll) and the bottom app bar.

items.name: appearance-picker
items.title: Appearance picker
items.description: End-user theme menu: a grid of looks (theme presets with their swatches) plus light / system / dark, as a popover or an inline panel.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: Fixed-ratio media frame plus the M3 media placeholder and corner label.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: File drop zone, upload rows with type tiles and progress, composer chips, thumbnails, and a useFileUploads hook for upload state.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initials, image or icon avatars in five sizes; circle, square or Expressive shapes; presence status; overlapping groups with overflow.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: M3 small (dot) and large (count) badges, BadgeAnchor to pin them to icons, and StatusBadge labels.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumbs with chevron or slash separators, a tonal current crumb, a collapsed-path menu and a compact back crumb.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Common buttons and toggle buttons: 5 styles × 5 sizes, round or square, with shape morph on press.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Standard button groups (press widens, neighbours squish), connected button groups, split buttons with a menu, and outlined segmented buttons.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: M3 date-picker calendar and range calendar (40dp day cells, today outline, range band, year grid) plus a month-view event calendar.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Elevated, filled and outlined cards with header, media, content and action parts; CardButton / CardLink for whole-card actions.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: M3 Expressive carousels: multi-browse, hero and center-aligned hero with keyline masking, plus uncontained and full-screen (vertical, autoplay). Parallax media, fading labels, dots, count, prev/next, drag and keyboard.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts themed with M3 color roles: ChartContainer with a role-based config, inverse-surface tooltips, dot legends, axis/grid defaults, Sparkline and a half-doughnut Gauge. Follows dark mode and seed colors live.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: M3 checkbox: selected, indeterminate, error and disabled states.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Assist, filter (animated check), input (removable, avatar) and suggestion chips, plus ChipGroup, InputChipGroup and ChipInput.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code block with filename header, line numbers, diff rows, language tabs and copy; one-line CodeCommand; CopyButton; InlineCode.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Text field that filters an Expressive menu as you type; match highlighting, multi-select chips, loading and empty states.

items.name: command
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K command palette: filterable grouped actions with shortcuts in a top-aligned dialog, or inline.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The Expressive menu opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press or Shift+F10.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Interactive data table on React Aria's Table: sorting, checkbox row selection, column resizing, row-action menus, search toolbar, pagination footer, density, loading and empty states, plus a useDataTable hook for client-side search/sort/paging.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date & time field
items.description: DateField and TimeField: segment inputs in the M3 text-field shell.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: M3 docked date and range pickers, modal date and range picker dialogs with calendar / input modes.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Basic and alert dialogs with focus management and enter/exit motion.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: DirectionProvider (dir + React Aria locale) and useDirection for RTL layouts.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: 1dp outline-variant divider: full, inset, middle-inset, vertical, or with a label.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Expressive shape + icon, headline, description and actions for empty, error and no-results states.

items.name: fab
items.title: Floating action button
items.description: FAB (40/56/80/96), extended FAB with animated collapse, and the Expressive FAB menu that morphs into a close button and staggers its items in.
items.docs: The FAB menu's item animation lives in expressive.css (fab-menu-item-enter). Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates it.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: External-label form anatomy: Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, Input, TextArea, Fieldset, FieldLegend.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Material Symbols Rounded glyph with fill, weight and optical-size axes.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: Icon buttons and toggle icon buttons: 4 styles × 5 sizes × 3 widths.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: Addons attached to an input: prefixes/suffixes, inline actions, joined selects. Outlined or pill.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code / PIN input: segmented cells over a single real input (paste, SMS autofill, a11y).
items.docs: Needs the field-*/caret/search additions in expressive.css. Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys and shortcut groups (chords and sequences).

items.name: link-button
items.title: Link button
items.description: A React Aria Link styled exactly like Button (buttonVariants): every style, size, shape and color, with ripple and client-side routing.

items.name: list
items.title: List

items.name: loading-indicator
items.title: Loading indicator
items.description: Morphing, rotating shape for short indeterminate waits.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Map pins, location dots, density clusters, status pins, numbered tour markers, legends and coach marks.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: M3 Expressive menus: standard and vibrant, segmented sections, leading icons, shortcuts, submenus and checkable items.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Desktop-style row of menu triggers with arrow-key and hover switching.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat bubbles with grouped corner shaping, delivery status, reactions with a picker, typing indicator, quotes, voice messages and hover actions.
items.docs: Uses the m3-message-in and m3-typing keyframes from expressive.css — re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: Chat thread container: header, a scroll region that sticks to the newest message and keeps its place when history loads, sticky date pills, jump-to-latest FAB with unread count, and a growing composer.

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation bar
items.description: M3 Expressive 64dp navigation bar: vertical or horizontal items, spring active indicator, badges, adaptive layout.

items.name: navigation-drawer
items.title: Navigation drawer
items.description: Standard and modal M3 navigation drawers with headlines, badges, dense items and collapsible nested groups.
items.docs: Uses keyframes added to expressive.css (m3-rail-in/out). Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site header with flyout and mega-menu panels.

items.name: navigation-rail
items.title: Navigation rail
items.description: Collapsed ⇄ expanded M3 Expressive navigation rail with menu button, FAB, sections, badges and a modal expanded mode.
items.docs: Uses keyframes added to expressive.css (m3-rail-in/out). Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbered, connected (Expressive) and compact range pagination plus carousel dots.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored surface-container popovers and hover cards that grow from their anchor.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress indicators
items.description: Linear and circular progress: determinate, indeterminate and the Expressive wavy variants, with track gap and stop indicator.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: One-question-per-step flow with progress, animated step transitions, large choice cards (single or multiple) and a 0–10 rating scale.
items.docs: Uses the m3-step-in keyframes from expressive.css — re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: M3 radio group with a spring-in dot, state layer, error, descriptions and trailing placement.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panes (react-resizable-panels) with the M3 pane drag handle that morphs to a 12×52 grip while dragging.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Scroll-triggered fade-up (Reveal) and staggered headline words (RevealWords).

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: Press ripple for any interactive element.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: M3 search bar and search view (docked or full screen) with live-filtered suggestions.
items.docs: Needs the field-*/caret/search additions in expressive.css. Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Exposed dropdown menu: the TextField shell (outlined or filled, floating label) opening an Expressive menu.

items.name: shape
items.title: Shape
items.description: The M3 Expressive shape library. Any two shapes morph smoothly via CSS clip-path.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Modal and standard bottom sheets (drag handle, drag to dismiss, peek/expand) and modal and standard side sheets.
items.docs: Needs the m3-sheet-* keyframes in expressive.css. Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Adaptive product sidebar: full drawer-style sidebar, 96dp rail, or modal drawer by window size class; groups, collapsible sections, header/footer menus.
items.docs: Uses keyframes added to expressive.css (m3-rail-in/out). Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Pulse or shimmer placeholders that mirror the final layout, plus SkeletonText.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: M3 Expressive slider: XS–XL inset tracks, gapped handle, stops, value indicator, range, centered, vertical, inset icon.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: Queued, announced M3 snackbars with an imperative snackbar() API, actions, close icon and spring enter/exit.
items.docs: Mount <SnackbarRegion /> once near your app root, then call snackbar("Saved").

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: M3 switch with spring handle and optional icons.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Plain content tables: caption, label headers, outline-variant dividers, tabular numerals, totals footer. Plain, striped, grid and card-row variants, dense density, sortable headers.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: M3 primary and secondary tabs plus segmented pill tabs, with a sliding indicator, icons, badges, scrolling and vertical orientation.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: M3 filled and outlined text fields: floating (notched) label, icons, prefix/suffix, supporting text, error, counter, multiline. Exports FieldContainer for other field-like controls.
items.docs: Needs the field-*/caret/search additions in expressive.css. Re-add @expressive/theme if your copy predates them.

items.name: theme-presets
items.title: Theme presets
items.description: 42 complete looks (color, surfaces, typeface, shape, elevation) for ThemeProvider and ThemeScope, including Henon, Pulse and 20 built from coolors.co trending palettes, plus presetCss() for SSR.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme provider
items.description: Light/dark/system mode, dynamic color from a seed (M3 2025 color spec) and theme presets.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: M3 time picker: draggable clock dial (12h / 24h two rings), hour/minute selectors, AM/PM, input mode, dialog.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked toasts with a role-colored icon, title, description, actions or custom content, via toast({ ... }).
items.docs: Mount <ToastRegion /> once near your app root, then call toast({ title, description, icon, tone }).

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Floating toolbars (standard/vibrant, horizontal/vertical, optional paired FAB) and docked toolbars, with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Plain and rich tooltips with M3 timing.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: Step timelines for agent runs, pipelines and request traces: status rail, mono durations, collapsible tool I/O, error detail, span waterfall, horizontal pipeline and status rows.

items.name: adaptive-scaffold
items.title: Adaptive scaffold
items.description: M3 navigation suite: navigation bar + FAB on compact windows, a collapsed rail (modal when opened) on medium and expanded, an expanded rail with brand and extended FAB on large and up.

items.name: admin-dashboard
items.title: Admin dashboard
items.description: Kestrel admin portal: 21 pages (overview, analytics, users, orders, products, customers, invoices, inventory, reports, calendar, inbox, support, projects, team, integrations, developers, audit log, settings, account) with adaptive navigation — nav bar → rail → expanded rail.
items.docs: Render <AdminDashboard page="overview" basePath="/admin" />. Pages: overview, analytics, users, orders, products, settings, customers, customer (id), order (id), invoices, inventory, reports, calendar, inbox, support, projects, team, integrations, developers, audit, account. For client-side routing wrap it in React Aria's <RouterProvider navigate={…} useHref={…}> and pass `navigate` for clickable rows.

items.name: app-shell-3

items.name: chart-card-3

items.name: chart-states
items.title: Chart states & legends
items.description: Loading, empty, error, permission, offline, partial, stale, updating, zero, filtered, low-sample and annotated chart states, tooltip anatomy, the series palette and four legend patterns.

items.name: comparison-charts

items.description: 24 bar charts: grouped, stacked, horizontal, diverging, 100%, combo, waterfall, histogram, floating, lollipop, dumbbell, target, pareto, ±, range, box plot, progress, pyramid, highlight, status, radial bars and grouped-stacked.

items.title: Composition charts
items.description: 17 share and conversion charts: doughnuts, pies, gauges, polar area, nested doughnut, funnels, sunburst, rose, 100% columns and a single stacked bar.

items.name: dashboard-data-display
items.title: Lists, tables & feeds
items.description: 26 data-display widgets: sortable leaderboard, ranked customers, activity, goals, incidents, period comparison, key-value details, region health, notifications, releases, agenda, SLA timers, plan tiers, log viewer, job queue, stat tabs and an audit trail.

items.name: dashboard-kit
items.title: Dashboard kit
items.description: The whole kit page: hero, sticky filter bar (date range · compare · shuffle) and every section — 75 charts, 27 visualizations, 24 KPI cards, 26 data-display widgets and chart states.

items.name: dashboard-kit-core
items.title: Dashboard kit · core

items.name: dashboard-viz

items.description: 26 SVG and Tailwind-grid visualizations: deploy calendar, alert matrix, uptime bars, treemap, bullets, gauges, rings, gantt, waffle, month heatmap, pipeline, dependency graph, hex grid, meters and more.

items.name: data-table-block-1
items.title: Data table · players with bulk actions
items.description: Search, status filter chips, sortable columns, row selection with a contextual action bar, and pagination.

items.name: data-table-block-2
items.title: Data table · moderation queue
items.description: Severity-tagged reports that expand to show evidence and history; acting on a report clears it, with undo.

items.name: data-table-block-3
items.title: Data table · events by status
items.description: Rows grouped under sticky status headers with participation bars, an inline live switch and a row menu.
